title: A Night Out With Tractor
label: Sept 18
where: Queens County Farm, Floral Park, NY
desc: Farmers, funders, environmental activists, land-back organizers, and journalists around one table. A summer menu by Chef Will Coleman of PLATED Studios, dessert by Gatas NYC, and then Erykah Badu and The Alchemist at Forest Hills Stadium.

title: Uptown Boogie Healthy Project Ag Summit
label: Mar 21
desc: Farmers, urban growers, city officials, workforce organizations, and youth under one roof, with groups like Farm School NYC, Hot Bread Kitchen, LaGuardia Community College, and Liberation Farm, plus on-site soil testing from a mobile soil lab.

title: BUGS Conference
label: Oct 24–25
detail: Black Farmers & Urban Gardeners Conference · RSVP open
desc: The annual Black Farmers & Urban Gardeners Conference, the largest national gathering for Black urban and rural farmers, growers, and land stewards. This year's themes: Rooted, Rising, Reimagine, and Reconstruction.

title: Anne Saxelby Legacy Fund Benefit
label: Sept 17
desc: An annual culinary celebration with more than 130 of New York City's chefs, mixologists, and artisans, raising money for monthlong, fully paid sustainable farm apprenticeships for young adults.

title: One Love Community Fridge Block Party
label: Aug 29
host: One Love Community Fridge and Little Grenjai
desc: A summer block party with food from Lori Jayne, TERANGA, Win Son, Ferrane Bakery, and Ace's Pizza, produce from Katzman, and workshops by Bloom Farm and Project EATS.

title: CultureCon 2026
label: Oct 3–4
detail: The festival's 10th year, themed "Museum of Us"
desc: Two festival days for Black and multicultural creatives, entrepreneurs, and cultural leaders, following a week of dinners, screenings, and community events across New York City.

title: Black Farmer Fund Work Day at FarmerJawn
label: Sept 30
desc: Black Farmer Fund work days bring volunteers onto the land to help Black farmers and land stewards with heavy farm labor. FarmerJawn Agriculture is a 128-acre regenerative organic produce farm led by founder and farmer Christa Barfield.

title: Vegan Solidarity Dinner
label: Oct 14
desc: A plant-based dinner with East New York Farms, with a Swahili-Colombian menu by local vegan chefs, supporting local animal welfare.

title: Regenerative NYC Summit
label: Apr 29–30
where: New Lab, Brooklyn Navy Yard, NY
desc: Two days with farmers, investors, researchers, food brands, supply chain leaders, and policymakers: talks, workshops, and a regenerative market.

title: A Night Out
label: May 29
detail: Chef Russell Markus of Essential Herbs
desc: The first Night Out in New York City. A menu built from farmers markets and close farm relationships, for fifteen guests across soil science, composting, CSAs, content, and kitchens, closing with a show at Brooklyn Steel.

title: The Fresh Food Connect Harvest Gathering
label: Oct 3
detail: Gardeners from IFCS and Kaizen Food Rescue
desc: A gathering for gardeners from Integrated Family Community Services and Kaizen Food Rescue, celebrating a season of backyard harvests turned into meals for neighbors. Time to swap stories and tips, a look at what Fresh Food Connect has been up to, and a collection of donations from everyone who came.

title: Industry Night
label: Oct 19
desc: The Libi Project's Industry Night, a gathering for chefs, food entrepreneurs, and culinary folks.
